game_name: Naomi DIMM Firmware Update for CF-BOX (4.01) (GDS-0042A)
general_issues: Select ndcfboxa.zip or the merged parent archive naomigd.zip. Select the exact set in Game Revision; merged archives must contain that revision. Required CHD: gds-0042a.chd. Select CHD Root below the ROM ZIP; disks may be in the set/parent subfolder or directly in that folder.
